summary_1line: Bhishma, Drona, Vidura, and Dhritarashtra urge Duryodhana to make peace with the Pandavas before war unleashes devastating heroes.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma and Drona stand in the royal assembly pleading with stubborn Duryodhana as kings watch in tense silence.
Elders describe Bhima stalking the battlefield with his mace, smashing warriors and elephants as heads fall like ripe palm fruits.
A vision of reconciliation: Yudhishthira embracing Duryodhana while the Pandava brothers and gathered kings weep with relief.
